request.prompt: A fixed-camera moving portrait crop of two adult interview guests seated in rust-red and forest-green armchairs in a plaster room. Both chairs and both faces remain visible. One guest nods and the other closes a small notebook. The larger continuing shot above and below shows ceiling and wood floor. A single tiny horizontal moving strip sits at the left in a generous black margin, outside the area with the chairs, and gives an alternate framing of those same subjects. Bright north light and a restrained film-grain texture. No text. Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.
